query:
WITH updated AS (
            UPDATE email_messages m
            SET
                is_read = $1,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE
                m.id = ANY($2)
                AND m.link_id = $3
            RETURNING m.thread_id
        )
        UPDATE email_threads t
        SET updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE t.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT thread_id FROM updated)
